notes: SqueekToken is a fixed-supply ERC-20 named squeek (SQK) with 18 decimals. Its parameterless constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 tokens to msg.sender, the deploying factory at launch. It has no owner, additional minting, burning, transfer fees, or upgrade mechanism. There are no application contracts or initialization calls. pool.initialPrice records provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and the total supply.
